field.usage: Chooses the aspect ratio/size of the flex-layout PayPal Pay Later banner on the catalog product page. Applies only when that banner is displayed and its style layout is flex. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Layout style of the PayPal Pay Later banner on product detail pages.
field.usage: Selects the layout style of the Pay Later banner on product pages. Applies only when the product-page Pay Later banner is displayed. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Text color of the PayPal Pay Later message on product detail pages.
field.usage: Selects the text color of the PayPal Pay Later message on the Catalog Product Page, from the available color options. Applies only when the product-page message is enabled and its style layout is set to Text. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Text size of the PayPal Pay Later banner on product pages.
field.usage: Sets the size of the message text in the Pay Later banner on catalog product pages. Applies only when the product-page Pay Later banner is displayed with a text style layout.

field.summary: Turns PayPal Pay Later promotional banners on or off across the storefront.
field.usage: Master switch for advertising PayPal Pay Later messaging. When Yes, the Pay Later banners configured for each page are eligible to show. Can be set per website.

field.summary: The email address of the PayPal merchant account that will receive payments.
field.usage: The email tied to your PayPal merchant (business) account — the address payments are credited to. Optional on this screen; PayPal can also be set up via the API credentials instead. Can be set per website for stores that bill under different PayPal accounts.

field.summary: Buyer country used to simulate transactions while sandbox mode is on.
field.usage: A country selected from the directory country list, used to simulate the buyer's country for Payflow Link testing. Applies only when Sandbox Mode is enabled. Can be set per website.

field.summary: The Payflow Partner ID that identifies your PayPal/Payflow account to the gateway.
field.usage: The Partner value supplied by PayPal or an authorized reseller that identifies the Payflow Link account when connecting to the gateway. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Hostname or IP of the proxy server used for Payflow Link API calls.
field.usage: The proxy host that Payflow Link API requests are routed through. Applies only when Use Proxy is enabled. Can be set per website.

field.summary: TCP port of the proxy server for Payflow Link; valid range is 0 to 65535. Applies only when Use Proxy is enabled.
field.usage: The port of the HTTP proxy used for Payflow Link gateway requests. Must be between 0 and 65535. Applies only when Use Proxy is enabled. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Encrypted password that authenticates the store's PayPal Payflow Link account.
field.usage: The password used to authenticate the merchant's Payflow Link account with PayPal. Stored encrypted. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Runs Payflow Link against the PayPal sandbox instead of live processing.
field.usage: When Yes, transactions use the PayPal sandbox (test) environment rather than live processing.

field.summary: Whether Payflow Link connects to PayPal through a proxy server.
field.usage: Chooses whether requests to PayPal are routed through a proxy server (Yes/No). Can be set per website.

field.summary: Payflow Link user login, stored encrypted; re-enter your Vendor/Merchant login if you have no extra users.
field.usage: The Payflow user login used to authenticate with the gateway, stored encrypted. If your account has no additional users set up, re-enter your Vendor/Merchant login here. Can be set per website.

field.summary: The vendor (merchant login) that identifies the merchant's Payflow account.
field.usage: The Payflow vendor / merchant login ID that identifies the merchant's PayPal Payflow account when connecting to the gateway. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Whether the payment is only authorized, or authorized and captured, when the order is placed.
field.usage: Chooses how funds are handled when an order is placed via Payflow Express — typically Authorization (hold funds for later capture) or Sale (authorize and capture immediately). Can be set per website.

field.summary: Whether this method is offered in all allowed countries or only specific ones.
field.usage: Chooses whether PayPal Express (Payflow) is available from All Allowed Countries or only from Specific Countries you select. Can be set per website.

values.value: Offer this method in every country your store already allows.
Limit this method to the specific countries you pick below.

field.summary: Whether Payflow Express Checkout API calls are logged for debugging.
field.usage: When Yes, requests and responses exchanged with PayPal for Payflow Express Checkout are written to the debug log. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Whether individual cart line items are sent to PayPal with the order.
field.usage: When Yes, the cart's individual line items are transferred to PayPal alongside the order totals; No sends only totals.

field.summary: Whether the order review step is skipped after returning from PayPal.
field.usage: When Yes, the order is placed immediately after PayPal instead of showing the order review page; No keeps the review step.

field.summary: Countries the Payflow Express Checkout method is offered to when limited to specific countries.
field.usage: Selects which countries can use this payment method. Applies only when Payment Applicable From is set to specific countries. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Whether SSL/TLS peer verification is enforced on Payflow Express API connections.
field.usage: When Yes, the SSL certificate of PayPal's endpoint is verified on Payflow Express API connections; when No, verification is skipped. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Whether the Express Checkout shortcut button appears on the shopping cart.
field.usage: Controls whether the PayPal/Payflow Express Checkout shortcut button is shown on the shopping cart page; it also affects the mini-cart. Store-view scoped, so placement can differ per view.

values.value: Show the PayPal shortcut button (PayPal's recommended choice).
Hide the PayPal shortcut button.

field.summary: Display order of Payflow Express Checkout among payment methods at checkout.
field.usage: Sets the position of Payflow Express Checkout in the list of payment methods at checkout (lower numbers appear first). Can be set per store view.

field.summary: The payment method name shown to customers at checkout.
field.usage: The title displayed for this PayPal Express (Payflow) method during checkout. Can be set per website or store view.

field.summary: Whether the Payflow Express Checkout button appears on product detail pages.
field.usage: When Yes, the Payflow Express Checkout button is shown on the product details page; when No, it is not. Can be set per website and per store view.

field.summary: Whether the order amount is authorized only, or authorized and captured, at checkout.
field.usage: Chooses how Payflow Link processes the payment when an order is placed, such as authorizing the amount only or authorizing and capturing it. Uses PayPal's payment-action options.

field.summary: Whether Payflow Link is offered to all countries or only selected ones.
field.usage: Chooses whether the method is available from all allowed countries or only a specific list. When restricted, the countries are chosen in a separate setting. Can be set per website.

values.value: Offer this method in every country your store already allows.
Limit this method to the specific countries you pick below.

field.summary: Whether the buyer can edit the card security code (CVV) field.
field.usage: When Yes, the CVV / card security code entry is editable by the buyer; when No, it is not. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Whether customers must enter the card security code (CVV) at checkout.
field.usage: When Yes, the card's CVV/CSC must be entered at checkout. Applies only when CVV editing is enabled. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Whether Payflow Link API calls are logged for debugging.
field.usage: Yes logs Payflow Link API requests and responses for troubleshooting; No disables logging. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Whether PayPal sends an order confirmation email for Payflow Link transactions.
field.usage: When Yes, PayPal sends an email confirmation for Payflow Link payments; when No, it does not. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Which PayPal logo image is shown on catalog pages and the homepage.
field.usage: Selects the PayPal product logo displayed on catalog pages and the homepage (or none). The image is served by PayPal in the chosen style. Store-view scoped, so each view can show a different logo or none.

field.summary: Name of a custom PayPal-hosted payment page style to apply.
field.usage: The name of a custom payment page layout (page style) configured in the merchant's PayPal account, applied to the PayPal-hosted pages shown during checkout. Can be set per website or store view.

field.summary: Background color of the header area on PayPal-hosted checkout pages.
field.usage: Sets the header background color shown on PayPal-hosted pages during checkout, part of the Frontend Experience Settings. Can be set per website and per store view.

field.summary: Color of the header border shown on PayPal-hosted pages.
field.usage: Sets the color used for the border of the header area on PayPal-hosted checkout pages. Can be set per store view.

field.summary: URL of the image shown in the header of PayPal-hosted checkout pages.
field.usage: The image URL displayed at the top of the PayPal-hosted pages customers see during checkout. Can differ per store view.

field.summary: Background color for the PayPal-hosted checkout/payment pages.
field.usage: Sets the page background color shown on the PayPal-hosted (Payflow) checkout and payment pages, so they can match your store's look. Part of the Frontend Experience styling; applies per store view.

field.summary: Whether PayPal settlement reports are fetched automatically on a schedule.
field.usage: When Yes, settlement reports are retrieved from PayPal automatically on a schedule; No requires fetching them manually.

field.summary: Hostname or IP of the server PayPal settlement reports are fetched from.
field.usage: The endpoint the settlement-report fetch job connects to; the native note records the default as reports.paypal.com. Used only for live fetching — it depends on the sandbox FTP flag being off. Can differ per website.

field.summary: Username used to sign in to the server where PayPal settlement reports are fetched.
field.usage: The login used to authenticate to the (S)FTP server from which settlement reports are downloaded. Stored encrypted. Can be set per website.

field.summary: The SFTP password used to fetch PayPal settlement reports.
field.usage: The password for the SFTP account PayPal uses to deliver settlement reports. Stored encrypted. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Directory on PayPal's SFTP server where settlement reports are fetched from.
field.usage: The remote path from which PayPal settlement reports are downloaded. Used for live (non-sandbox) fetching. Website-scoped; leave at the default /ppreports/outgoing unless PayPal directs otherwise.

field.summary: Whether settlement reports are fetched from PayPal's sandbox server instead of the live one.
field.usage: When Yes, PayPal settlement reports are retrieved from the sandbox (test) SFTP server rather than the production server. Can be set per website.

field.summary: How often Magento fetches PayPal settlement reports.
field.usage: Frequency at which Magento retrieves settlement reports from PayPal via SFTP. PayPal retains these reports for 45 days, so fetch often enough to avoid gaps. Global (default) scope.

field.summary: Time of day when the PayPal settlement report is fetched.
field.usage: Sets the time of day at which Magento retrieves the settlement report from PayPal, part of Settlement Report Settings.

field.summary: The specific countries from which Payflow Link payments are accepted.
field.usage: Selects the countries allowed to use Payflow Link. Applies only when 'Payment Applicable From' is set to specific countries. Multiple countries can be chosen; can be set per website.

field.summary: The HTTP method used for the Payflow Link cancel and return URLs.
field.usage: Selects the HTTP method used when PayPal redirects back to the store's cancel and return URLs. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Whether SSL peer verification is enforced on Payflow Link connections.
field.usage: When Yes, the SSL certificate of the Payflow Link endpoint is verified on each connection; when No, verification is skipped. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Display order of Payflow Link among the payment methods at checkout.
field.usage: Sets the position of the Payflow Link method relative to other payment methods in the checkout list; a lower number places it higher.

field.summary: The Payflow Link method name shown to customers at checkout; recommended value is "Debit or Credit Card".
field.usage: The label customers see for the Payflow Link payment method at checkout. It is recommended to set this to "Debit or Credit Card", and it can be set differently per store view.

field.summary: Yes adds the PayPal Credit (financing) button to Express Checkout.
field.usage: Turns the PayPal Credit financing option on or off for Express Checkout. When Yes, an integrated button lets eligible buyers pay over time while you are paid up front; it still only appears to buyers PayPal deems eligible.

field.summary: Enables or disables the PayPal Pay Later experience.
field.usage: Turns the PayPal Pay Later experience on or off for this PayPal solution. When No, Pay Later messaging and banners are not offered. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Your PayPal-issued publisher ID that identifies the account the PayPal Credit advertising banner is served for.
field.usage: The publisher identifier PayPal issues for the Advertise PayPal Credit program. It must be supplied for the credit banner to render; without it no banner is displayed. Enter the value from your PayPal account rather than guessing. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Whether the PayPal Pay Later banner is shown on the storefront category page.
field.usage: Turns the PayPal Pay Later (Bill Me Later) promotional banner on or off on the category page. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Placement of the PayPal Pay Later (BML) banner on catalog category pages.
field.usage: Chooses where the Pay Later / Bill Me Later promotional banner appears on catalog category pages. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Size of the PayPal Credit (Bill Me Later) banner shown on catalog category pages.
field.usage: Chooses the display size of the PayPal Credit / Bill Me Later promotional banner on the Catalog Category Page, from the available banner sizes. Applies only for the configured category-page banner position, and can be set per website.

field.summary: Size of the PayPal Credit (Bill Me Later) banner shown on catalog category pages.
field.usage: Chooses the display size of the PayPal Credit / Bill Me Later promotional banner on the Catalog Category Page, from the available banner sizes. Applies only for the configured category-page banner position, and can be set per website.

field.summary: Shows the PayPal Bill Me Later promotional banner on the shopping cart page.
field.usage: When Yes, the PayPal Bill Me Later (PayPal Credit) banner appears on the shopping cart page; No hides it.

field.summary: Placement of the PayPal Credit (BML) banner on the checkout shopping cart page.
field.usage: Chooses where the PayPal Credit (Pay Later/BML) advertising banner appears on the checkout cart page. The available placements come from PayPal's banner position options. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Display size of the PayPal Credit (BML) banner on the shopping cart page.
field.usage: Sets the size of the PayPal Credit / Banner-based-lending promo banner shown on the Checkout Cart Page. Applies only when the cart-page banner's Position is set to the matching layout option. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Display size of the PayPal Credit (BML) banner on the shopping cart page.
field.usage: Sets the size of the PayPal Credit / Banner-based-lending promo banner shown on the Checkout Cart Page. Applies only when the cart-page banner's Position is set to the matching layout option. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Whether the PayPal Pay Later banner is shown on the storefront home page.
field.usage: Turns the PayPal Pay Later (Bill Me Later) promotional banner on or off on the home page. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Placement of the PayPal Pay Later (BML) banner on the storefront home page.
field.usage: Chooses where the Pay Later / Bill Me Later promotional banner appears on the home page. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Size of the PayPal Credit (Bill Me Later) banner shown on the home page.
field.usage: Chooses the display size of the PayPal Credit / Bill Me Later promotional banner on the Home Page, from the available banner sizes. Applies only for the configured home-page banner position, and can be set per website.

field.summary: Size of the PayPal Credit (Bill Me Later) banner shown on the home page.
field.usage: Chooses the display size of the PayPal Credit / Bill Me Later promotional banner on the Home Page, from the available banner sizes. Applies only for the configured home-page banner position, and can be set per website.

field.summary: Shows the PayPal Bill Me Later promotional banner on catalog product pages.
field.usage: When Yes, the PayPal Bill Me Later (PayPal Credit) banner appears on catalog product pages; No hides it.

field.summary: Placement of the PayPal Credit (BML) banner on the catalog product page.
field.usage: Chooses where the PayPal Credit (Pay Later/BML) advertising banner appears on product detail pages. Placements come from PayPal's banner position options. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Display size of the PayPal Credit (BML) banner on the product page.
field.usage: Sets the size of the PayPal Credit / Banner-based-lending promo banner shown on the Catalog Product Page. Applies only when the product-page banner's Position is set to the matching layout option. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Display size of the PayPal Credit (BML) banner on the product page.
field.usage: Sets the size of the PayPal Credit / Banner-based-lending promo banner shown on the Catalog Product Page. Applies only when the product-page banner's Position is set to the matching layout option. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Turns PayPal Pay Later promotional banners on or off across the storefront.
field.usage: Master switch for advertising PayPal Pay Later messaging. When Yes, the Pay Later banners configured for each page are eligible to show. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Color of the PayPal Pay Later banner on the shopping cart page.
field.usage: Selects the color variant of the Pay Later banner shown on the cart page. Applies only when the cart-page Pay Later banner is displayed and its style layout is set to flex. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Whether the PayPal Pay Later message is shown on the shopping cart page.
field.usage: When Yes, the PayPal Pay Later promotional message appears on the Checkout Cart Page; when No, it is hidden. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Placement of the logo within the PayPal Pay Later banner on the cart page.
field.usage: Sets where the logo sits inside the Pay Later messaging banner on the shopping cart page. Applies only when the cart-page Pay Later banner is displayed with a text style layout.

field.summary: Logo variant for the PayPal Pay Later message on the shopping cart page.
field.usage: Selects which PayPal Pay Later logo style is shown in the cart-page message. Applies only when the cart-page Pay Later message is displayed and its style layout is set to text. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Where the PayPal Pay Later banner is placed on the shopping cart page.
field.usage: Chooses the placement of the Pay Later banner on the Checkout Cart Page from the available positions. Applies only when the cart-page Pay Later banner Display is enabled. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Aspect ratio of the flex-layout PayPal Pay Later banner on the shopping cart page.
field.usage: Chooses the aspect ratio/size of the flex-layout PayPal Pay Later banner on the cart page. Applies only when that banner is displayed and its style layout is flex. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Layout style of the PayPal Pay Later banner on the shopping cart page.
field.usage: Selects the layout style of the Pay Later banner on the cart page. Applies only when the cart-page Pay Later banner is displayed. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Text color of the PayPal Pay Later message on the cart page.
field.usage: Selects the text color of the PayPal Pay Later message on the Checkout Cart Page, from the available color options. Applies only when the cart-page Pay Later message is enabled and its style layout is set to Text. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Text size of the PayPal Pay Later banner on the cart page.
field.usage: Sets the size of the message text in the Pay Later banner on the shopping cart page. Applies only when the cart-page Pay Later banner is displayed with a text style layout.

field.summary: Color scheme for the PayPal Pay Later message on catalog category pages.
field.usage: Selects the color scheme of the PayPal Pay Later banner shown on catalog category pages. Applies only when the category-page Pay Later message is displayed and its style layout is set to flex. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Whether the PayPal Pay Later banner is shown on category pages.
field.usage: When Yes, the PayPal Pay Later promotional banner appears on the Catalog Category Page; when No, it is hidden. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Position of the PayPal logo within the Pay Later text banner on the category page.
field.usage: Where the PayPal logo sits within the text-layout Pay Later banner on the category page. Applies only when that banner is displayed with a text style layout and a primary/alternative logo type. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Logo style of the PayPal Pay Later banner on catalog category pages.
field.usage: Selects the logo style of the Pay Later banner on category pages. Applies only when the category-page Pay Later banner is displayed and its style layout is set to text. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Placement of the PayPal Pay Later message on catalog category pages.
field.usage: Chooses where the PayPal Pay Later message is placed on the Catalog Category Page, from the available positions. Applies only when the category-page Pay Later message is enabled. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Aspect ratio of the PayPal Pay Later banner on category pages.
field.usage: Sets the shape/aspect ratio of the Pay Later banner on catalog category pages. Applies only when the category-page Pay Later banner is displayed with a flex style layout.

field.summary: Layout style of the PayPal Pay Later message on catalog category pages.
field.usage: Chooses the layout format of the PayPal Pay Later banner on catalog category pages, which in turn determines whether a logo-type or color option applies. Applies only when the category-page Pay Later message is displayed. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Text color of the Pay Later banner on category pages.
field.usage: Selects the text color for the Pay Later banner on the Catalog Category Page from PayPal's allowed color options. Applies only when the category-page banner Display is enabled and its style layout is Text. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Text size of the PayPal Pay Later text banner on the category page.
field.usage: Sets the text size of the text-layout PayPal Pay Later banner on the category page. Applies only when that banner is displayed with a text style layout. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Color of the PayPal Pay Later banner on the checkout payment step.
field.usage: Selects the color variant of the Pay Later banner shown on the checkout payment step. Applies only when that banner is displayed and its style layout is set to flex. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Whether the PayPal Pay Later message is shown at the checkout payment step.
field.usage: When Yes, the PayPal Pay Later promotional message appears at the Checkout Payment Step; when No, it is hidden. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Placement of the logo within the PayPal Pay Later banner at the checkout payment step.
field.usage: Sets where the logo sits inside the Pay Later banner on the checkout payment step. Applies only when that Pay Later banner is displayed with a text style layout.

field.summary: Logo variant for the PayPal Pay Later message on the checkout payment step.
field.usage: Selects which PayPal Pay Later logo style is shown during the checkout payment step. Applies only when that Pay Later message is displayed and its style layout is set to text. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Where the PayPal Pay Later banner is placed at the checkout payment step.
field.usage: Chooses the placement of the Pay Later banner on the Checkout Payment Step from the available positions. Applies only when the payment-step Pay Later banner Display is enabled. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Aspect ratio of the flex-layout PayPal Pay Later banner on the checkout payment step.
field.usage: Chooses the aspect ratio/size of the flex-layout PayPal Pay Later banner on the checkout payment step. Applies only when that banner is displayed and its style layout is flex. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Layout style of the PayPal Pay Later banner on the checkout payment step.
field.usage: Selects the layout style of the Pay Later banner on the checkout payment step. Applies only when that banner is displayed. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Text color of the PayPal Pay Later message at the checkout payment step.
field.usage: Selects the text color of the PayPal Pay Later message at the Checkout Payment Step, from the available color options. Applies only when that message is enabled and its style layout is set to Text. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Text size of the PayPal Pay Later banner at the checkout payment step.
field.usage: Sets the size of the message text in the Pay Later banner on the checkout payment step. Applies only when that Pay Later banner is displayed with a text style layout.

field.summary: Color scheme for the PayPal Pay Later message on the home page.
field.usage: Selects the color scheme of the PayPal Pay Later banner shown on the storefront home page. Applies only when the home-page Pay Later message is displayed and its style layout is set to flex. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Whether the PayPal Pay Later banner is shown on the home page.
field.usage: When Yes, the PayPal Pay Later promotional banner appears on the Home Page; when No, it is hidden. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Position of the PayPal logo within the Pay Later text banner on the home page.
field.usage: Where the PayPal logo sits within the text-layout Pay Later banner on the home page. Applies only when that banner is displayed with a text style layout and a primary/alternative logo type. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Logo style of the PayPal Pay Later banner on the storefront home page.
field.usage: Selects the logo style of the Pay Later banner on the home page. Applies only when the home-page Pay Later banner is displayed and its style layout is set to text. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Placement of the PayPal Pay Later message on the home page.
field.usage: Chooses where the PayPal Pay Later message is placed on the Home Page, from the available positions. Applies only when the home-page Pay Later message is enabled. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Aspect ratio of the PayPal Pay Later banner on the home page.
field.usage: Sets the shape/aspect ratio of the Pay Later banner on the home page. Applies only when the home-page Pay Later banner is displayed with a flex style layout.

field.summary: Layout style of the PayPal Pay Later message on the home page.
field.usage: Chooses the layout format of the PayPal Pay Later banner on the home page. Applies only when the home-page Pay Later message is displayed. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Text color of the Pay Later banner on the home page.
field.usage: Selects the text color for the Pay Later banner on the Home Page from PayPal's allowed color options. Applies only when the home-page banner Display is enabled and its style layout is Text. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Text size of the PayPal Pay Later text banner on the home page.
field.usage: Sets the text size of the text-layout PayPal Pay Later banner on the home page. Applies only when that banner is displayed with a text style layout. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Color of the PayPal Pay Later banner on product detail pages.
field.usage: Selects the color variant of the Pay Later banner shown on product pages. Applies only when that banner is displayed and its style layout is set to flex. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Whether the PayPal Pay Later message is shown on product detail pages.
field.usage: When Yes, the PayPal Pay Later promotional message appears on the Catalog Product Page; when No, it is hidden. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Placement of the logo within the PayPal Pay Later banner on product pages.
field.usage: Sets where the logo sits inside the Pay Later banner on catalog product pages. Applies only when the product-page Pay Later banner is displayed with a text style layout.

field.summary: Logo variant for the PayPal Pay Later message on product pages.
field.usage: Selects which PayPal Pay Later logo style is shown in the product-page message. Applies only when the product-page Pay Later message is displayed and its style layout is set to text. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Where the PayPal Pay Later banner is placed on product pages.
field.usage: Chooses the placement of the Pay Later banner on the Catalog Product Page from the available positions. Applies only when the product-page Pay Later banner Display is enabled. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Aspect ratio of the flex-layout PayPal Pay Later banner on the product page.
field.usage: Chooses the aspect ratio/size of the flex-layout PayPal Pay Later banner on the catalog product page. Applies only when that banner is displayed and its style layout is flex. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Layout style of the PayPal Pay Later banner on product detail pages.
field.usage: Selects the layout style of the Pay Later banner on product pages. Applies only when the product-page Pay Later banner is displayed. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Text color of the PayPal Pay Later message on product detail pages.
field.usage: Selects the text color of the PayPal Pay Later message on the Catalog Product Page, from the available color options. Applies only when the product-page message is enabled and its style layout is set to Text. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Text size of the PayPal Pay Later banner on product pages.
field.usage: Sets the size of the message text in the Pay Later banner on catalog product pages. Applies only when the product-page Pay Later banner is displayed with a text style layout.

field.summary: Enables the PayPal Payments Pro Hosted Solution payment method.
field.usage: Turns the PayPal Payments Pro Hosted Solution on or off (Yes/No). Can be set per website.

field.summary: The method used to authenticate Magento's calls to the PayPal API.
field.usage: Selects how the store authenticates to PayPal's API for Express Checkout (for example, by the type of API credential used). Can be set per website.

values.value: Authenticate to PayPal with an API signature (username, password, signature).
Authenticate to PayPal with an uploaded API certificate instead of a signature.

field.summary: API certificate file used to authenticate the store's PayPal account for Express Checkout.
field.usage: Uploads the PayPal API certificate that identifies and authenticates the merchant's PayPal account for Express Checkout API calls. Used instead of API signature credentials when certificate authentication is selected. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Password that authenticates Express Checkout API calls to the merchant's PayPal account.
field.usage: The API password used to authenticate Express Checkout API requests against the merchant's PayPal account. Stored encrypted, and can differ per website.

field.summary: API signature credential used to authenticate the store with your PayPal account.
field.usage: The PayPal API signature that authenticates requests from the store to your PayPal account. Stored encrypted. Applies when API signature authentication is in use. Can be set per website.

field.summary: The PayPal API username that identifies the merchant's account for Express Checkout.
field.usage: The API username used to identify and authenticate the merchant's PayPal account for Express Checkout API calls. Stored encrypted. Can be set per website.

field.summary: The email address of the PayPal merchant account that will receive payments.
field.usage: The email tied to your PayPal merchant (business) account — the address payments are credited to. Optional on this screen; PayPal can also be set up via the API credentials instead. Can be set per website for stores that bill under different PayPal accounts.

field.summary: Country used to simulate the buyer's location when testing Express Checkout in sandbox mode.
field.usage: Selects a buyer country, from the country list, to emulate during sandbox testing of PayPal Express Checkout. Applies only when sandbox mode is enabled. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Hostname or IP of the proxy server used for PayPal API calls.
field.usage: The proxy host that PayPal API requests are routed through. Applies only when Use Proxy is enabled. Can be set per website.

field.summary: TCP port of the proxy server used for PayPal API calls.
field.usage: The port on the proxy host that PayPal API requests are routed through. Applies only when Use Proxy is enabled. Valid range is 0–65535. Website-scoped.

field.summary: Whether Express Checkout runs against the PayPal sandbox instead of the live environment.
field.usage: When Yes, Express Checkout uses the PayPal sandbox for testing; when No, it processes live transactions. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Whether PayPal API calls are routed through a proxy server.
field.usage: When Yes, Express Checkout API requests are sent through a proxy host; No connects to PayPal directly.

field.summary: Whether the Express Checkout button appears in the Payment Information step.
field.usage: When Yes, the PayPal Express Checkout button is shown during the Payment Information step of checkout; when No, it is hidden. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Whether the payment is only authorized, or authorized and captured, when the order is placed.
field.usage: Chooses how funds are handled for PayPal Payments Pro Hosted Solution orders — typically Authorization (hold funds for later capture) or Sale (authorize and capture immediately). Can be set per website.

field.summary: Whether this method is offered in all allowed countries or only specific ones.
field.usage: Chooses whether PayPal Payments Pro Hosted Solution is available from All Allowed Countries or only from Specific Countries. Can be set per website.

values.value: Offer this method in every country your store already allows.
Limit this method to the specific countries you pick below.

field.summary: Whether Payments Pro Hosted Solution API calls are logged for debugging.
field.usage: When Yes, requests and responses exchanged with PayPal for the Hosted Pro method are written to the debug log. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Whether PayPal settlement reports are fetched automatically on a schedule.
field.usage: When Yes, settlement reports are retrieved from PayPal automatically on a schedule; No requires fetching them manually.

field.summary: Hostname or IP of the server PayPal settlement reports are fetched from.
field.usage: The endpoint the settlement-report fetch job connects to; the native note records the default as reports.paypal.com. Used only for live fetching — it depends on the sandbox FTP flag being off. Can differ per website.

field.summary: Username used to sign in to the server where PayPal settlement reports are fetched.
field.usage: The login used to authenticate to the (S)FTP server from which settlement reports are downloaded. Stored encrypted. Can be set per website.

field.summary: The SFTP password used to fetch PayPal settlement reports.
field.usage: The password for the SFTP account PayPal uses to deliver settlement reports. Stored encrypted. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Directory on PayPal's SFTP server where settlement reports are fetched from.
field.usage: The remote path from which PayPal settlement reports are downloaded. Used for live (non-sandbox) fetching. Website-scoped; leave at the default /ppreports/outgoing unless PayPal directs otherwise.

field.summary: Whether settlement reports are fetched from PayPal's sandbox server instead of the live one.
field.usage: When Yes, PayPal settlement reports are retrieved from the sandbox (test) SFTP server rather than the production server. Can be set per website.

field.summary: How often Magento fetches PayPal settlement reports.
field.usage: Frequency at which Magento retrieves settlement reports from PayPal via SFTP. PayPal retains these reports for 45 days, so fetch often enough to avoid gaps. Global (default) scope.

field.summary: Time of day when the PayPal settlement report is fetched.
field.usage: Sets the time of day at which Magento retrieves the settlement report from PayPal, part of Settlement Report Settings.

field.summary: The countries from which this payment method may be used.
field.usage: Selects the countries allowed to use this payment method. Applies only when payment is restricted to specific countries. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Whether PayPal's SSL certificate is verified on gateway API calls.
field.usage: When Yes, the SSL/TLS certificate of PayPal's endpoint is verified when the gateway connects (recommended). Can be set per website.

field.summary: Display order of this method relative to other payment methods at checkout.
field.usage: The position of PayPal Payments Pro Hosted Solution in the list of payment methods at checkout; lower numbers appear first. Can be set per website or store view.

field.summary: The method name shown to customers for PayPal Payments Pro Hosted Solution at checkout.
field.usage: The label buyers see for this payment method during checkout and on order documents. The native note suggests setting it to "PayPal" per store view; being store-scoped, it can differ by store view (e.g. for localisation).

technical.default_value: Payment by cards or by PayPal account

field.summary: Yes adds the PayPal Credit (financing) button to Express Checkout.
field.usage: Turns the PayPal Credit financing option on or off for Express Checkout. When Yes, an integrated button lets eligible buyers pay over time while you are paid up front; it still only appears to buyers PayPal deems eligible.

field.summary: Enables or disables the PayPal Pay Later experience.
field.usage: Turns the PayPal Pay Later experience on or off for this PayPal solution. When No, Pay Later messaging and banners are not offered. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Your PayPal-issued publisher ID that identifies the account the PayPal Credit advertising banner is served for.
field.usage: The publisher identifier PayPal issues for the Advertise PayPal Credit program. It must be supplied for the credit banner to render; without it no banner is displayed. Enter the value from your PayPal account rather than guessing. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Whether the PayPal Pay Later banner is shown on the storefront category page.
field.usage: Turns the PayPal Pay Later (Bill Me Later) promotional banner on or off on the category page. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Placement of the PayPal Pay Later (BML) banner on catalog category pages.
field.usage: Chooses where the Pay Later / Bill Me Later promotional banner appears on catalog category pages. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Size of the PayPal Credit (Bill Me Later) banner shown on catalog category pages.
field.usage: Chooses the display size of the PayPal Credit / Bill Me Later promotional banner on the Catalog Category Page, from the available banner sizes. Applies only for the configured category-page banner position, and can be set per website.

field.summary: Size of the PayPal Credit (Bill Me Later) banner shown on catalog category pages.
field.usage: Chooses the display size of the PayPal Credit / Bill Me Later promotional banner on the Catalog Category Page, from the available banner sizes. Applies only for the configured category-page banner position, and can be set per website.

field.summary: Shows the PayPal Bill Me Later promotional banner on the shopping cart page.
field.usage: When Yes, the PayPal Bill Me Later (PayPal Credit) banner appears on the shopping cart page; No hides it.

field.summary: Placement of the PayPal Credit (BML) banner on the checkout shopping cart page.
field.usage: Chooses where the PayPal Credit (Pay Later/BML) advertising banner appears on the checkout cart page. The available placements come from PayPal's banner position options. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Display size of the PayPal Credit (BML) banner on the shopping cart page.
field.usage: Sets the size of the PayPal Credit / Banner-based-lending promo banner shown on the Checkout Cart Page. Applies only when the cart-page banner's Position is set to the matching layout option. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Display size of the PayPal Credit (BML) banner on the shopping cart page.
field.usage: Sets the size of the PayPal Credit / Banner-based-lending promo banner shown on the Checkout Cart Page. Applies only when the cart-page banner's Position is set to the matching layout option. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Whether the PayPal Pay Later banner is shown on the storefront home page.
field.usage: Turns the PayPal Pay Later (Bill Me Later) promotional banner on or off on the home page. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Placement of the PayPal Pay Later (BML) banner on the storefront home page.
field.usage: Chooses where the Pay Later / Bill Me Later promotional banner appears on the home page. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Size of the PayPal Credit (Bill Me Later) banner shown on the home page.
field.usage: Chooses the display size of the PayPal Credit / Bill Me Later promotional banner on the Home Page, from the available banner sizes. Applies only for the configured home-page banner position, and can be set per website.

field.summary: Size of the PayPal Credit (Bill Me Later) banner shown on the home page.
field.usage: Chooses the display size of the PayPal Credit / Bill Me Later promotional banner on the Home Page, from the available banner sizes. Applies only for the configured home-page banner position, and can be set per website.

field.summary: Shows the PayPal Bill Me Later promotional banner on catalog product pages.
field.usage: When Yes, the PayPal Bill Me Later (PayPal Credit) banner appears on catalog product pages; No hides it.

field.summary: Placement of the PayPal Credit (BML) banner on the catalog product page.
field.usage: Chooses where the PayPal Credit (Pay Later/BML) advertising banner appears on product detail pages. Placements come from PayPal's banner position options. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Display size of the PayPal Credit (BML) banner on the product page.
field.usage: Sets the size of the PayPal Credit / Banner-based-lending promo banner shown on the Catalog Product Page. Applies only when the product-page banner's Position is set to the matching layout option. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Display size of the PayPal Credit (BML) banner on the product page.
field.usage: Sets the size of the PayPal Credit / Banner-based-lending promo banner shown on the Catalog Product Page. Applies only when the product-page banner's Position is set to the matching layout option. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Turns PayPal Pay Later promotional banners on or off across the storefront.
field.usage: Master switch for advertising PayPal Pay Later messaging. When Yes, the Pay Later banners configured for each page are eligible to show. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Color of the PayPal Pay Later banner on the shopping cart page.
field.usage: Selects the color variant of the Pay Later banner shown on the cart page. Applies only when the cart-page Pay Later banner is displayed and its style layout is set to flex. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Whether the PayPal Pay Later message is shown on the shopping cart page.
field.usage: When Yes, the PayPal Pay Later promotional message appears on the Checkout Cart Page; when No, it is hidden. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Placement of the logo within the PayPal Pay Later banner on the cart page.
field.usage: Sets where the logo sits inside the Pay Later messaging banner on the shopping cart page. Applies only when the cart-page Pay Later banner is displayed with a text style layout.

field.summary: Logo variant for the PayPal Pay Later message on the shopping cart page.
field.usage: Selects which PayPal Pay Later logo style is shown in the cart-page message. Applies only when the cart-page Pay Later message is displayed and its style layout is set to text. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Where the PayPal Pay Later banner is placed on the shopping cart page.
field.usage: Chooses the placement of the Pay Later banner on the Checkout Cart Page from the available positions. Applies only when the cart-page Pay Later banner Display is enabled. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Aspect ratio of the flex-layout PayPal Pay Later banner on the shopping cart page.
field.usage: Chooses the aspect ratio/size of the flex-layout PayPal Pay Later banner on the cart page. Applies only when that banner is displayed and its style layout is flex. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Layout style of the PayPal Pay Later banner on the shopping cart page.
field.usage: Selects the layout style of the Pay Later banner on the cart page. Applies only when the cart-page Pay Later banner is displayed. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Text color of the PayPal Pay Later message on the cart page.
field.usage: Selects the text color of the PayPal Pay Later message on the Checkout Cart Page, from the available color options. Applies only when the cart-page Pay Later message is enabled and its style layout is set to Text. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Text size of the PayPal Pay Later banner on the cart page.
field.usage: Sets the size of the message text in the Pay Later banner on the shopping cart page. Applies only when the cart-page Pay Later banner is displayed with a text style layout.

field.summary: Color scheme for the PayPal Pay Later message on catalog category pages.
field.usage: Selects the color scheme of the PayPal Pay Later banner shown on catalog category pages. Applies only when the category-page Pay Later message is displayed and its style layout is set to flex. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Whether the PayPal Pay Later banner is shown on category pages.
field.usage: When Yes, the PayPal Pay Later promotional banner appears on the Catalog Category Page; when No, it is hidden. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Position of the PayPal logo within the Pay Later text banner on the category page.
field.usage: Where the PayPal logo sits within the text-layout Pay Later banner on the category page. Applies only when that banner is displayed with a text style layout and a primary/alternative logo type. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Logo style of the PayPal Pay Later banner on catalog category pages.
field.usage: Selects the logo style of the Pay Later banner on category pages. Applies only when the category-page Pay Later banner is displayed and its style layout is set to text. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Placement of the PayPal Pay Later message on catalog category pages.
field.usage: Chooses where the PayPal Pay Later message is placed on the Catalog Category Page, from the available positions. Applies only when the category-page Pay Later message is enabled. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Aspect ratio of the PayPal Pay Later banner on category pages.
field.usage: Sets the shape/aspect ratio of the Pay Later banner on catalog category pages. Applies only when the category-page Pay Later banner is displayed with a flex style layout.

field.summary: Layout style of the PayPal Pay Later message on catalog category pages.
field.usage: Chooses the layout format of the PayPal Pay Later banner on catalog category pages, which in turn determines whether a logo-type or color option applies. Applies only when the category-page Pay Later message is displayed. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Text color of the Pay Later banner on category pages.
field.usage: Selects the text color for the Pay Later banner on the Catalog Category Page from PayPal's allowed color options. Applies only when the category-page banner Display is enabled and its style layout is Text. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Text size of the PayPal Pay Later text banner on the category page.
field.usage: Sets the text size of the text-layout PayPal Pay Later banner on the category page. Applies only when that banner is displayed with a text style layout. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Color of the PayPal Pay Later banner on the checkout payment step.
field.usage: Selects the color variant of the Pay Later banner shown on the checkout payment step. Applies only when that banner is displayed and its style layout is set to flex. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Whether the PayPal Pay Later message is shown at the checkout payment step.
field.usage: When Yes, the PayPal Pay Later promotional message appears at the Checkout Payment Step; when No, it is hidden. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Placement of the logo within the PayPal Pay Later banner at the checkout payment step.
field.usage: Sets where the logo sits inside the Pay Later banner on the checkout payment step. Applies only when that Pay Later banner is displayed with a text style layout.

field.summary: Logo variant for the PayPal Pay Later message on the checkout payment step.
field.usage: Selects which PayPal Pay Later logo style is shown during the checkout payment step. Applies only when that Pay Later message is displayed and its style layout is set to text. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Where the PayPal Pay Later banner is placed at the checkout payment step.
field.usage: Chooses the placement of the Pay Later banner on the Checkout Payment Step from the available positions. Applies only when the payment-step Pay Later banner Display is enabled. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Aspect ratio of the flex-layout PayPal Pay Later banner on the checkout payment step.
field.usage: Chooses the aspect ratio/size of the flex-layout PayPal Pay Later banner on the checkout payment step. Applies only when that banner is displayed and its style layout is flex. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Layout style of the PayPal Pay Later banner on the checkout payment step.
field.usage: Selects the layout style of the Pay Later banner on the checkout payment step. Applies only when that banner is displayed. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Text color of the PayPal Pay Later message at the checkout payment step.
field.usage: Selects the text color of the PayPal Pay Later message at the Checkout Payment Step, from the available color options. Applies only when that message is enabled and its style layout is set to Text. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Text size of the PayPal Pay Later banner at the checkout payment step.
field.usage: Sets the size of the message text in the Pay Later banner on the checkout payment step. Applies only when that Pay Later banner is displayed with a text style layout.

field.summary: Color scheme for the PayPal Pay Later message on the home page.
field.usage: Selects the color scheme of the PayPal Pay Later banner shown on the storefront home page. Applies only when the home-page Pay Later message is displayed and its style layout is set to flex. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Whether the PayPal Pay Later banner is shown on the home page.
field.usage: When Yes, the PayPal Pay Later promotional banner appears on the Home Page; when No, it is hidden. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Position of the PayPal logo within the Pay Later text banner on the home page.
field.usage: Where the PayPal logo sits within the text-layout Pay Later banner on the home page. Applies only when that banner is displayed with a text style layout and a primary/alternative logo type. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Logo style of the PayPal Pay Later banner on the storefront home page.
field.usage: Selects the logo style of the Pay Later banner on the home page. Applies only when the home-page Pay Later banner is displayed and its style layout is set to text. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Placement of the PayPal Pay Later message on the home page.
field.usage: Chooses where the PayPal Pay Later message is placed on the Home Page, from the available positions. Applies only when the home-page Pay Later message is enabled. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Aspect ratio of the PayPal Pay Later banner on the home page.
field.usage: Sets the shape/aspect ratio of the Pay Later banner on the home page. Applies only when the home-page Pay Later banner is displayed with a flex style layout.

field.summary: Layout style of the PayPal Pay Later message on the home page.
field.usage: Chooses the layout format of the PayPal Pay Later banner on the home page. Applies only when the home-page Pay Later message is displayed. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Text color of the Pay Later banner on the home page.
field.usage: Selects the text color for the Pay Later banner on the Home Page from PayPal's allowed color options. Applies only when the home-page banner Display is enabled and its style layout is Text. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Text size of the PayPal Pay Later text banner on the home page.
field.usage: Sets the text size of the text-layout PayPal Pay Later banner on the home page. Applies only when that banner is displayed with a text style layout. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Color of the PayPal Pay Later banner on product detail pages.
field.usage: Selects the color variant of the Pay Later banner shown on product pages. Applies only when that banner is displayed and its style layout is set to flex. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Whether the PayPal Pay Later message is shown on product detail pages.
field.usage: When Yes, the PayPal Pay Later promotional message appears on the Catalog Product Page; when No, it is hidden. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Placement of the logo within the PayPal Pay Later banner on product pages.
field.usage: Sets where the logo sits inside the Pay Later banner on catalog product pages. Applies only when the product-page Pay Later banner is displayed with a text style layout.

field.summary: Logo variant for the PayPal Pay Later message on product pages.
field.usage: Selects which PayPal Pay Later logo style is shown in the product-page message. Applies only when the product-page Pay Later message is displayed and its style layout is set to text. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Where the PayPal Pay Later banner is placed on product pages.
field.usage: Chooses the placement of the Pay Later banner on the Catalog Product Page from the available positions. Applies only when the product-page Pay Later banner Display is enabled. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Aspect ratio of the flex-layout PayPal Pay Later banner on the product page.
field.usage: Chooses the aspect ratio/size of the flex-layout PayPal Pay Later banner on the catalog product page. Applies only when that banner is displayed and its style layout is flex. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Layout style of the PayPal Pay Later banner on product detail pages.
field.usage: Selects the layout style of the Pay Later banner on product pages. Applies only when the product-page Pay Later banner is displayed. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Text color of the PayPal Pay Later message on product detail pages.
field.usage: Selects the text color of the PayPal Pay Later message on the Catalog Product Page, from the available color options. Applies only when the product-page message is enabled and its style layout is set to Text. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Text size of the PayPal Pay Later banner on product pages.
field.usage: Sets the size of the message text in the Pay Later banner on catalog product pages. Applies only when the product-page Pay Later banner is displayed with a text style layout.

field.summary: Enables the PayPal Payments Pro Hosted Solution payment method.
field.usage: Turns the PayPal Payments Pro Hosted Solution on or off (Yes/No). Can be set per website.

field.summary: The method used to authenticate Magento's calls to the PayPal API.
field.usage: Selects how the store authenticates to PayPal's API for Express Checkout (for example, by the type of API credential used). Can be set per website.

values.value: Authenticate to PayPal with an API signature (username, password, signature).
Authenticate to PayPal with an uploaded API certificate instead of a signature.

field.summary: API certificate file used to authenticate the store's PayPal account for Express Checkout.
field.usage: Uploads the PayPal API certificate that identifies and authenticates the merchant's PayPal account for Express Checkout API calls. Used instead of API signature credentials when certificate authentication is selected. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Password that authenticates Express Checkout API calls to the merchant's PayPal account.
field.usage: The API password used to authenticate Express Checkout API requests against the merchant's PayPal account. Stored encrypted, and can differ per website.

field.summary: API signature credential used to authenticate the store with your PayPal account.
field.usage: The PayPal API signature that authenticates requests from the store to your PayPal account. Stored encrypted. Applies when API signature authentication is in use. Can be set per website.

field.summary: The PayPal API username that identifies the merchant's account for Express Checkout.
field.usage: The API username used to identify and authenticate the merchant's PayPal account for Express Checkout API calls. Stored encrypted. Can be set per website.

field.summary: The email address of the PayPal merchant account that will receive payments.
field.usage: The email tied to your PayPal merchant (business) account — the address payments are credited to. Optional on this screen; PayPal can also be set up via the API credentials instead. Can be set per website for stores that bill under different PayPal accounts.

field.summary: Country used to simulate the buyer's location when testing Express Checkout in sandbox mode.
field.usage: Selects a buyer country, from the country list, to emulate during sandbox testing of PayPal Express Checkout. Applies only when sandbox mode is enabled. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Hostname or IP of the proxy server used for PayPal API calls.
field.usage: The proxy host that PayPal API requests are routed through. Applies only when Use Proxy is enabled. Can be set per website.

field.summary: TCP port of the proxy server used for PayPal API calls.
field.usage: The port on the proxy host that PayPal API requests are routed through. Applies only when Use Proxy is enabled. Valid range is 0–65535. Website-scoped.

field.summary: Whether Express Checkout runs against the PayPal sandbox instead of the live environment.
field.usage: When Yes, Express Checkout uses the PayPal sandbox for testing; when No, it processes live transactions. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Whether PayPal API calls are routed through a proxy server.
field.usage: When Yes, Express Checkout API requests are sent through a proxy host; No connects to PayPal directly.

field.summary: Whether the Express Checkout button appears in the Payment Information step.
field.usage: When Yes, the PayPal Express Checkout button is shown during the Payment Information step of checkout; when No, it is hidden. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Days a PayPal order authorization stays honored; must match your PayPal account setting.
field.usage: The authorization honor period (in days) that PayPal guarantees funds for an order authorization. Applies only when Payment Action is Order, and it must mirror the value configured on your PayPal account. Website scope.

field.summary: How many child authorizations PayPal may create under one order authorization; the account default is 1.
field.usage: Number of child (partial) authorizations allowed against a single PayPal order authorization. The PayPal account default is 1; raising it requires PayPal to increase your limit. Applies only when the Express Checkout payment action is Order. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Days a PayPal order authorization stays valid; must match your PayPal account setting.
field.usage: Number of days the order remains valid, mirroring the Order Valid Period on your PayPal account — keep the two in sync. Applies only when Payment Action is Order. Can be set per website.

field.summary: The payment action used when an order is placed through PayPal Express Checkout.
field.usage: Selects how a PayPal Express Checkout order is processed at placement — the payment action applied to the transaction. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Whether a billing agreement is created when the buyer has no active one.
field.usage: Controls creation of a PayPal billing agreement during Express Checkout when the buyer has no active agreement. Billing agreements let a customer pay with PayPal later without re-authorising. The choice is a defined set of signup behaviours; set per website.

values.value: Create a billing agreement automatically where one is possible.
Ask the customer whether to set up a billing agreement.
Never offer a billing agreement at checkout.

field.summary: Whether PayPal Express Checkout applies to all allowed countries or only specific ones.
field.usage: Chooses whether PayPal Express Checkout is offered to all allowed countries or only to a specific list of countries (set in the related country field). Can be set per website.

values.value: Offer this method in every country your store already allows.
Limit this method to the specific countries you pick below.

field.summary: Visual style of the PayPal Express Checkout shortcut buttons.
field.usage: Selects the visual flavor of the PayPal shortcut (Express Checkout) buttons shown in the storefront. Can be set per website or store view.

field.summary: Whether PayPal Express Checkout API calls are logged for debugging.
field.usage: When Yes, requests and responses exchanged with PayPal for Express Checkout are written to the debug log. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Whether individual cart line items are sent to PayPal with the order.
field.usage: When Yes, each cart line item is transferred to PayPal so the itemized breakdown appears on the PayPal side; when No, only the order total is sent. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Whether a customer billing address is required during PayPal Express Checkout; must first be enabled on your PayPal account.
field.usage: Controls when a billing address is required for PayPal Express Checkout orders (for example never, always, or only for virtual orders). This capability must first be enabled for your merchant account through PayPal technical support. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Whether the order review step is skipped after returning from PayPal.
field.usage: When Yes, the order is placed immediately after PayPal instead of showing the order review page; No keeps the review step.

field.summary: Whether Express Checkout lets buyers pay without a PayPal account.
field.usage: Chooses the Express Checkout solution type — whether buyers can complete payment as a guest, without logging into or creating a PayPal account. Can be set per website.

values.value: Let shoppers pay without a PayPal account (guest checkout allowed).
Require shoppers to sign in to a PayPal account to pay.

field.summary: Countries PayPal Express Checkout is offered to when limited to specific countries.
field.usage: Selects which countries can use PayPal Express Checkout. Applies only when Payment Applicable From is set to specific countries. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Whether the cart's shipping options are passed to PayPal for selection there.
field.usage: When Yes, Magento transfers the available shipping options to PayPal so the buyer can pick one on PayPal. Applies only when line item details are enabled. PayPal accepts at most 10 options, so only the 10 cheapest are sent. Set per website.

field.summary: Whether SSL/TLS peer verification is enforced on Express Checkout API connections.
field.usage: When Yes, the SSL certificate of PayPal's endpoint is verified on Express Checkout API connections; when No, verification is skipped. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Shows the PayPal Express shortcut button on the shopping cart.
field.usage: Whether the PayPal Express Checkout shortcut button appears on the cart so shoppers can jump straight to PayPal. As the native note says, this also governs the mini-shopping-cart button. Can be set per website and store view.

values.value: Show the PayPal shortcut button (PayPal's recommended choice).
Hide the PayPal shortcut button.

field.summary: Display order of PayPal Express Checkout among payment methods at checkout.
field.usage: Sets the position of PayPal Express Checkout in the list of payment methods at checkout (lower numbers appear first). Can be set per store view.

field.summary: The PayPal Express method name customers see at checkout.
field.usage: The label shown for PayPal Express during checkout. Store-view scoped, so it can be translated or named differently per store view.

field.summary: Whether the PayPal Express Checkout button appears on product detail pages.
field.usage: Yes shows the PayPal Express Checkout button on product detail pages; No hides it. Can be set per website or store view.

field.summary: Whether the payment is only authorized, or authorized and captured, when the order is placed.
field.usage: Chooses how funds are handled for PayPal Payments Pro Hosted Solution orders — typically Authorization (hold funds for later capture) or Sale (authorize and capture immediately). Can be set per website.

field.summary: Whether this method is offered in all allowed countries or only specific ones.
field.usage: Chooses whether PayPal Payments Pro Hosted Solution is available from All Allowed Countries or only from Specific Countries. Can be set per website.

values.value: Offer this method in every country your store already allows.
Limit this method to the specific countries you pick below.

field.summary: Whether Payments Pro Hosted Solution API calls are logged for debugging.
field.usage: When Yes, requests and responses exchanged with PayPal for the Hosted Pro method are written to the debug log. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Enables the PayPal Billing Agreement payment option at checkout.
field.usage: Turns the PayPal Billing Agreement method on or off. As the native note says, it surfaces at checkout only for customers who already hold at least one active billing agreement, letting them pay without re-entering PayPal each time. Can differ per website.

field.summary: Whether customers can create a PayPal billing agreement from their account.
field.usage: When Yes, customers can set up a PayPal billing agreement through the wizard in their account area; No disables it.

field.summary: Whether the PayPal Billing Agreement method is offered to all countries or only selected ones.
field.usage: Chooses whether PayPal Billing Agreement is available from all allowed countries or only a specific list. When restricted, the countries are chosen in a separate setting. Can be set per website.

values.value: Offer this method in every country your store already allows.
Limit this method to the specific countries you pick below.

field.summary: Logs PayPal API request and response data for Billing Agreement troubleshooting.
field.usage: When Yes, PayPal Billing Agreement API calls are logged to help with troubleshooting; when No, logging is off. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Whether individual cart line items are sent to PayPal for billing-agreement orders.
field.usage: When Yes, each cart line item (name, quantity, price) is transferred to PayPal rather than only the order total, for PayPal Billing Agreement transactions. Can be set per website.

field.summary: How PayPal processes payment for billing-agreement orders.
field.usage: Selects the payment action PayPal performs for billing-agreement orders — for example, authorizing the amount only, or authorizing and capturing it. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Display order of PayPal Billing Agreement among payment methods at checkout.
field.usage: Sets the position of the PayPal Billing Agreement method relative to other payment methods at checkout; lower values appear first. Can be set per website and per store view.

field.summary: Countries whose buyers may use the PayPal billing agreement method.
field.usage: Restricts the PayPal billing agreement method to buyers from the selected countries. Applies only when payment is limited to specific countries.

field.summary: Checkout method name shown to customers for PayPal Billing Agreement.
field.usage: The label displayed to customers for the PayPal Billing Agreement payment method at checkout. Can differ per store view.

field.summary: Whether SSL/TLS peer verification is enforced on Billing Agreement API connections.
field.usage: When Yes, the SSL certificate of PayPal's endpoint is verified on Billing Agreement API connections; when No, verification is skipped. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Which PayPal logo image is shown on catalog pages and the homepage.
field.usage: Selects the PayPal product logo displayed on catalog pages and the homepage (or none). The image is served by PayPal in the chosen style. Store-view scoped, so each view can show a different logo or none.

field.summary: Name of a custom PayPal-hosted payment page style to apply.
field.usage: The name of a custom payment page layout (page style) configured in the merchant's PayPal account, applied to the PayPal-hosted pages shown during checkout. Can be set per website or store view.

field.summary: Background color of the header area on PayPal-hosted checkout pages.
field.usage: Sets the header background color shown on PayPal-hosted pages during checkout, part of the Frontend Experience Settings. Can be set per website and per store view.

field.summary: Color of the header border shown on PayPal-hosted pages.
field.usage: Sets the color used for the border of the header area on PayPal-hosted checkout pages. Can be set per store view.

field.summary: URL of the image shown in the header of PayPal-hosted checkout pages.
field.usage: The image URL displayed at the top of the PayPal-hosted pages customers see during checkout. Can differ per store view.

field.summary: Background color for the PayPal-hosted checkout/payment pages.
field.usage: Sets the page background color shown on the PayPal-hosted (Payflow) checkout and payment pages, so they can match your store's look. Part of the Frontend Experience styling; applies per store view.

field.summary: Whether PayPal settlement reports are fetched automatically on a schedule.
field.usage: When Yes, settlement reports are retrieved from PayPal automatically on a schedule; No requires fetching them manually.

field.summary: Hostname or IP of the server PayPal settlement reports are fetched from.
field.usage: The endpoint the settlement-report fetch job connects to; the native note records the default as reports.paypal.com. Used only for live fetching — it depends on the sandbox FTP flag being off. Can differ per website.

field.summary: Username used to sign in to the server where PayPal settlement reports are fetched.
field.usage: The login used to authenticate to the (S)FTP server from which settlement reports are downloaded. Stored encrypted. Can be set per website.

field.summary: The SFTP password used to fetch PayPal settlement reports.
field.usage: The password for the SFTP account PayPal uses to deliver settlement reports. Stored encrypted. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Directory on PayPal's SFTP server where settlement reports are fetched from.
field.usage: The remote path from which PayPal settlement reports are downloaded. Used for live (non-sandbox) fetching. Website-scoped; leave at the default /ppreports/outgoing unless PayPal directs otherwise.

field.summary: Whether settlement reports are fetched from PayPal's sandbox server instead of the live one.
field.usage: When Yes, PayPal settlement reports are retrieved from the sandbox (test) SFTP server rather than the production server. Can be set per website.

field.summary: How often Magento fetches PayPal settlement reports.
field.usage: Frequency at which Magento retrieves settlement reports from PayPal via SFTP. PayPal retains these reports for 45 days, so fetch often enough to avoid gaps. Global (default) scope.

field.summary: Time of day when the PayPal settlement report is fetched.
field.usage: Sets the time of day at which Magento retrieves the settlement report from PayPal, part of Settlement Report Settings.

field.summary: The countries from which this payment method may be used.
field.usage: Selects the countries allowed to use this payment method. Applies only when payment is restricted to specific countries. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Whether PayPal's SSL certificate is verified on gateway API calls.
field.usage: When Yes, the SSL/TLS certificate of PayPal's endpoint is verified when the gateway connects (recommended). Can be set per website.

field.summary: Display order of this method relative to other payment methods at checkout.
field.usage: The position of PayPal Payments Pro Hosted Solution in the list of payment methods at checkout; lower numbers appear first. Can be set per website or store view.

field.summary: The method name shown to customers for PayPal Payments Pro Hosted Solution at checkout.
field.usage: The label buyers see for this payment method during checkout and on order documents. The native note suggests setting it to "PayPal" per store view; being store-scoped, it can differ by store view (e.g. for localisation).

technical.default_value: Payment by cards or by PayPal account

field.summary: Yes adds the PayPal Credit (financing) button to Express Checkout.
field.usage: Turns the PayPal Credit financing option on or off for Express Checkout. When Yes, an integrated button lets eligible buyers pay over time while you are paid up front; it still only appears to buyers PayPal deems eligible.

field.summary: Enables or disables the PayPal Pay Later experience.
field.usage: Turns the PayPal Pay Later experience on or off for this PayPal solution. When No, Pay Later messaging and banners are not offered. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Your PayPal-issued publisher ID that identifies the account the PayPal Credit advertising banner is served for.
field.usage: The publisher identifier PayPal issues for the Advertise PayPal Credit program. It must be supplied for the credit banner to render; without it no banner is displayed. Enter the value from your PayPal account rather than guessing. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Whether the PayPal Pay Later banner is shown on the storefront category page.
field.usage: Turns the PayPal Pay Later (Bill Me Later) promotional banner on or off on the category page. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Placement of the PayPal Pay Later (BML) banner on catalog category pages.
field.usage: Chooses where the Pay Later / Bill Me Later promotional banner appears on catalog category pages. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Size of the PayPal Credit (Bill Me Later) banner shown on catalog category pages.
field.usage: Chooses the display size of the PayPal Credit / Bill Me Later promotional banner on the Catalog Category Page, from the available banner sizes. Applies only for the configured category-page banner position, and can be set per website.

field.summary: Size of the PayPal Credit (Bill Me Later) banner shown on catalog category pages.
field.usage: Chooses the display size of the PayPal Credit / Bill Me Later promotional banner on the Catalog Category Page, from the available banner sizes. Applies only for the configured category-page banner position, and can be set per website.

field.summary: Shows the PayPal Bill Me Later promotional banner on the shopping cart page.
field.usage: When Yes, the PayPal Bill Me Later (PayPal Credit) banner appears on the shopping cart page; No hides it.

field.summary: Placement of the PayPal Credit (BML) banner on the checkout shopping cart page.
field.usage: Chooses where the PayPal Credit (Pay Later/BML) advertising banner appears on the checkout cart page. The available placements come from PayPal's banner position options. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Display size of the PayPal Credit (BML) banner on the shopping cart page.
field.usage: Sets the size of the PayPal Credit / Banner-based-lending promo banner shown on the Checkout Cart Page. Applies only when the cart-page banner's Position is set to the matching layout option. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Display size of the PayPal Credit (BML) banner on the shopping cart page.
field.usage: Sets the size of the PayPal Credit / Banner-based-lending promo banner shown on the Checkout Cart Page. Applies only when the cart-page banner's Position is set to the matching layout option. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Whether the PayPal Pay Later banner is shown on the storefront home page.
field.usage: Turns the PayPal Pay Later (Bill Me Later) promotional banner on or off on the home page. Can be set per website.

field.summary: Placement of the PayPal Pay Later (BML) banner on the storefront home page.
